phase3_findings.description: --worktree resolved the post-image relative to CWD while --rev is repo-root-anchored; from a subdirectory every file is unresolvable, the run emits zero CU rows and exits 0, and the sweep records a clean pass having examined nothing

§2.3.4b's three-outcome routing is not closed: an empty diff stream yields zero rows AND exit 0, identical to the clean arm on the only observable the prose authorized; a failed producer lands in the clean arm
a lib/test/run.sh comment declared the five-element always-on enumeration 'must be UNCHANGED' while the same diff replaced it — a self-contradicting comment (PR-#553 class)
the CU tier did not recognize an emphasis-wrapped quantifier (**every** X), shrinking the seed list on real prose
an added line that cannot be located in the post-image is dropped with no breadcrumb; --worktree widens that window because the post-image is a mutable tree

two header sentences overclaimed: 'each added line fails its content anchor' (the code falls back to a whole-file text search) and 'Every exclusion this header documents' (one short, and the path exclusion is a whole-file skip)

no end-to-end --worktree run and no --rev differential; the modified-uncommitted-file shape, four prose_mask rows, the closed sets, the working-tree unparseable-.py arm and the failure-arm breadcrumb were all unasserted; the AC116 token assertion is a source scan that survives neutering the tier

§2.3.4b's arms are still not disjoint: a repo-root-unresolvable run DOES produce rows (a file-level '-' row per added line) while examining nothing, so it routes to arm 1 and records a clean discharge

the unlocated counter over-counts blank added lines (_locate rejects them by construction) and its breadcrumb names causes that do not apply; neither the counter nor the repo-root fallback breadcrumb had any test
the None post-image sentinel lets an embedding caller threading an unset value silently select working-tree mode and skip the only validation the helper has
the _REPO_ROOT module cache guaranteed per-run scoping only for callers entering through run(); the test suite already calls post_file_lines directly and passed only by monkeypatch ordering

three prose skews: the #466 guard's name-generic claim is falsified by CU/RT, Phase 0.6 does emit the new rows (it just does not act on them), and the docs' 'run on every diff' overclaims against 2.3.4b's own trigger heading
_CU_QUANT is labelled 'universal-quantifier tokens' but four of its twelve (only/complete/entire/whole) are scope claims
